items.q: What is grounded charisma, and why isn't Shawn Maguire the usual example?
items.a: Stay **calm and centered** enough to see the game and **choose a response** instead of getting pulled in. He is not Don Draper suave or Jack Reacher dominant — proof charisma can be this quieter sixth type after conviction, authentic, funny, empathetic, energetic.

items.q: What self-monitoring loop kills grounded charisma?
items.a: **How do I look / how do I sound / what are they thinking of me.** If you don't understand **why they behave that way**, you will take it personally.

items.q: What three theory-of-mind questions look past the surface fight?
items.a: **What is this behavior doing for them?** **Why do they need to?** **What response are they trying to pull out of me?** Attachment is a **code**, not an excuse for their whole personality.

items.q: What is in your control after someone like Will rattles you?
items.a: The **in-the-moment flinch** is often outside control — Shawn still blows up over his wife. **Processing after** (pattern, real conflict, then sleep) is yours.

items.q: What happens if you try to draw out a power-game withdrawal?
items.a: You teach them that **silence controls the relationship**. Shawn **falls asleep** in the silent hour. Ultimate control looks like **doing nothing** — so when they re-engage, you have **no leftover resentment**.

items.q: What is the rescue-animal version of the same move?
items.a: If you **need them to heal**, you are at your wit's end when they open and they **feel that pressure**. Relax in the room; don't overextend forcing a connection. **Boundary violations still get a walk-out.**

items.q: How should you share vulnerability with someone terrified of it?
items.a: Share something you are **comfortable getting nothing back from**. If you need reassurance or matching disclosure, your **state is in their hands**. Will punches the fart story; Shawn stays because he wasn't fishing.

items.q: How do you take criticism without collapsing complexity?
items.a: Ask **what part of this is actually for me?** Painting jab = Will's wound. Remarriage jab = **true** — Shawn puts his money back on the table. Grounded ≠ stubborn.

items.q: Why does Lambeau collapse when Will outshines him, and Shawn doesn't?
items.a: Lambeau's okay-ness is **Fields-medal number-one**. Shawn: **I know who I am** — conscious choice, not a mess-up. Ego off the line frees attention for the other person.

items.q: What attention rule can you run before you are fully self-accepting?
items.a: When uncomfortable, stop scanning phones and the room. The most interesting place is the **space between your noses** — even if you say you want to go home.
